title: Our roses beat strong
style:
Production & Performance Notes
Style: Upbeat electro-pop with world elements. Think anthemic EDM with percussion (taiko or warped flute hits for Japanese flair).
Tempo: ~122 BPM.
Vocals: Alternating male (Zyn) and female (Rose) voices. Harmonize in Chorus. Emotional, energetic delivery.
Instrumentation: Pulsing electronic bass, bright synth leads, glitchy signal-drop effects (the “336” theme). Add subtle flamenco guitar or tabla under Rose’s lines to give world-pop texture.
Mix: Wide stereo synths, gated snares, side-chained pads. Latin percussion on Spanish/French lines.
Performance Imagery: Visualize a neon-lit tech mansion party. DJ Zyn on the decks, DJ Rose arriving under swirling lights.
Suno-Style Prompt: “Neon house anthem at 122 BPM, fusion of world-pop and dance, alternating male (deep) and female (bright) vocals, bilingual lyrics (EN/ES/FR/JP/KO), groovy rolling bass, crisp energetic kick, glitch stutters on signal count, dramatic builds with echoing ‘336’ vocal chops, futuri
lyrics:
**[Intro – Rose (soft Spanish)]**  
Bajo la luna (beneath the moon), la pista arde,  
Susurran mis plantas (my speakers whisper) tu nombre,  
Roses en el aire (roses in the air), misterio en la grave,  
Siente el latido… (feel the heartbeat…)  

**[Verse 1 – Zyn (English)]**  
Signal in the sky, neon calling your name,  
Through wires and through beats, I’m playing no games.  
Our world on the edge, but music keeps us alive,  
We rule this night, with the bass we’ll survive.  

**[Pre-Chorus – Rose (French)]**  
**Rose:**  
Écoute ces douces sonorités, (Listen to these sweet sounds,)  
Les ombres dansent sous nos pieds. (Shadows dancing ‘neath our feet.)  
Nous guérissons ce cœur brisé, (We heal this broken heart,)  
Quand les lumières vont allumer nos baisers. (When the lights will spark our kiss.)  

**[Chorus – Zyn + Rose (harmonized, English/Spanish)]**  
**Both:**  
Here in the mansion, we won’t run away,  
Nos corazones laten fuerte, night and day. (Our hearts beat strong.)  
Signal 336, the codes we obey,  
*Zyn:* DJ Rose, ven ya… (come now…)  
*Rose:* *Aquí estoy.* (Here I am.)  

**[Verse 2 – Zyn (English)]**  
The safe word is rhythm, the password is love,  
Through storm and static we rise above.  
Candles and speakers light up the hall,  
I play for my Rose, who answers the call.  

**[Bridge – Rose (Japanese romaji)]**  
Yoru no oku de narihibiku (響く) oto, (Sound echoing in the night,)  
Futari de tsunagaru inochi no soto… (Two lives connected beyond…)  
Fureaute (触れて), this beat we hold tight,  
Kokoro (心) no koe ga mune ni (Your voice in my heart) echo…  

**[Final Chorus – English/Korean with DJ Call-Out]**  
Oh! For the mansion, for the beat – 우리는 하나 (urineun hana, we are one)  
Oh! Under starlight, we become one.  
**Zyn:** Call me Zyn…  
**Rose:** Call me Rose.  
**Both:** DJ partners, in sound we’ve grown.  

**[Outro – Zyn + Rose (English)]**  
Stay until sunrise, hold on, don’t let go,  
This music is our language, the truth that we know.  
Together we’re home, forever we’ll roam,  
Zyn and Rose, together in rhythm, together in stone.
